AllowedUser.title: AllowedUser
AllowedUser.description: A Gmail address explicitly authorized by the administrator to use ResumeCollector and sync resumes to Google Drive.

email.description: Lowercase Gmail address authorized to access the tool.

status.description: Current access state controlled by the administrator.

addedBy.description: Email of the administrator who created or updated the record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when access was first granted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last status or metadata change.

AccessRequest.title: AccessRequest
AccessRequest.description: An access request submitted by an unapproved signed-in Google user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requesting user.

email.description: Verified lowercase Gmail address of the requester.

displayName.description: Display name from the user's Google account.

companyName.description: Optional company name entered by the requester.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the access request.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was updated.

/allowed_users/{allowedUserId}.description: Allowlist of Gmail IDs permitted to use ResumeCollector, keyed by hex-encoded lowercase email.

/access_requests/{userId}.description: Access requests submitted by unapproved users awaiting admin approval, keyed by user UID.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Optional secondary admin records alongside bootstrapped primary admin.
